<subject>Team Meeting on May 9th</subject>
<body>
We will be holding a team meeting on Thursday, 9 May at 4 PM. Topics will include data labelling, market volatility impacts, and recent shifts in the Credit Risk unit. Pizza will be provided. I’d like to make these sessions monthly to stay ahead of the evolving regulatory landscape and keep everyone aligned on operational updates. If you’re unable to attend, or have specific items to raise, or a pizza preference, please advise me promptly.

Thanks,  
Brandon  
</body>
